title: Hardrock 100 Lottery - How the Lottery Works
claims: For the 2026 Hardrock, the 6 December 2025 lottery selected 147 entrants, split 64/83 between the Finished and Never Finished pools.
For 2026, 22.2% of applicants were women, and the percentage of women selected to start will not be less than the percentage of applicants.
The Never Finished pool gives 2^N tickets, where N is the number of previous DNSs since the applicant last started Hardrock.
The Finished pool gives one ticket for applying, one additional ticket per finish and one per DNS since the last start.
The Run Director may select six additional runners for 2026, evenly split between men and women.
The lottery is normally conducted at the beginning of December.
